title: Sindh High Density Development Board Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: Sindh High Density Development Board Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XLIV OF 2013
ACT XLIV OF 2013
SINDH HIGH DENSITY DEVELOPMENT BOARD
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act to amend the Sindh
High Density Development
Board Act, 2010
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
17th September, 2013]
No.PAS/Legis-B-06/2013,
dated 16-9-2013.---The Sindh High Density Development
Board (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 19th August, 2013 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 26th August, 2013 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
High Density Development Board Act, 2010, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh High Density Development Board
(Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

No.PAS/Legis-B-06/2013,

Board (Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 19th August, 2013 and assented to by the Governor

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh

It

"3. Constitution of Board.---Government shall constitute a Board for the cities of
the Province under this Act. The Board shall consist of the following:--
(i)
Chief Minister, Sindh
Chairman
(ii)
Minister, Local
Government and Housing
Town Planning
Department
Vice-Chairman
(iii)
Chief Secretary, Sindh
Member
(iv)
Secretary, Local
Government and Housing
Member
(v)
Mayor or as the case
may be Chairman of the respective Council
Member
(vi)
Chief Controller of
Buildings or as the case may be Head of Buildings Control of the respective
District.
Member as well as
Secretary
(vii)
Head of Master Plan of
the Respective Council.
Member.".
